name: Digital Signage Free Plan Changelog 2026
method: Each entry records what a vendor's own pricing or plans page said on the date it was read. Entries are appended, never rewritten, so the log shows what was true on any date.

entries.change: Pricing page read again: the free screen shows a ChannelOS banner along the bottom of the screen (our 2026-09-18 entry said no watermark; corrected). Solo at $5 per screen per month yearly or $6 monthly removes the banner; Pro $8 yearly or $10 monthly; Agency $200 per month yearly for 25 screens, then $6 per screen.
entries.free_plan_after: 1 screen, forever, with a ChannelOS banner

entries.change: Pricing page now publishes plans: Free is 10 screens as a 3-month free trial with a watermark on screens; Home Basic $52 per month for 10 screens with no watermark and $6.49 per screen per month from the 11th screen; Business Pro $520 per month unlimited screens; Enterprise Plus $830 per month. Terms: free screens for 3 months from first registration, new customers only, offer may be modified or cancelled. The homepage still says "First 10 screens free" without the 3-month or watermark caveats.
entries.free_plan_after: 10 screens for 3 months, with a watermark; then from $52 per month

entries.change: Re-verified with the plan cards: 2 players free forever; each new player $35 for the first year (licence plus subscription), then $20 per year from the second year (shown as $1.67 per month billed annually); over 50 screens is a sales quote.

Xibo Cloud prices read from the pricing page: Professional $4.90 per display per month ($58.80 a year), Business $7.70, Enterprise $12.60, all including Android, Windows, webOS, Tizen and ChromeOS players and hosting, 14-day trial with 2 players. Self-hosted commercial player licences, one-time perpetual: Android $28, webOS $85, Tizen $85, ChromeOS $49; Windows and Linux players free. The self-hosted CMS stays free and open source.
entries.free_plan_after: Unlimited, self-hosted (Windows and Linux players free)

entries.change: Verified: 1 screen free forever, no watermark, never flips to paid when more screens are added; paid screens $5 to $6 per screen per month, volume tiers after 25 screens. First entry.
Verified: MIT-licensed open-source server (self-host free, unlimited) plus a managed cloud with a free plan (1 display) and a 14-day Pro trial, no credit card. First entry.
Re-verified, unchanged: first 3 screens free forever, no credit card, no ads, no watermark, 1 GB storage, about 90% of features; then $3 per screen per month (Plus+) or the one-time $895 mediaSERVER.
entries.free_plan_after: 3 screens, forever, no ads, no watermark

entries.change: Homepage description now reads 'Free Digital Signage Software for three months, start free with 10 screens, no credit card required'. Through summer 2026 the site advertised up to 10 free screens with a note that the offer may change. Paid rates still not published.
entries.free_plan_after: 10 screens, described as free for three months

entries.change: Re-verified, unchanged: 3 screens free with OptiSigns branding shown on screen; $10 Standard to $30 Engage per screen per month.
Re-verified, unchanged: 2 screens free; annual license after, about $1.67 per screen per month; players for Raspberry Pi and, per the vendor, Android TV and the Amazon Signage Stick.
Re-verified, unchanged: no permanent free tier, trial only; from $20 per screen per month (Core).
Re-verified, unchanged: free open-source server, unlimited screens when self-hosted; Android, webOS and Tizen players are paid licenses; Xibo Cloud is paid.
Re-verified, unchanged: free, one Raspberry Pi per screen, each managed on its own, no central cloud.

Free plan ended for new accounts: new sign-ups get a 30-day trial of up to 5 screens instead of 1 free screen. Existing accounts keep the free tier only while they have exactly 1 screen. Paid from $8 Basic, $12 Premium, $16 Enterprise per screen per month.
